Home.title: Music under complete control.
Home.copy: VLT Studio Pro brings recording, arranging, plugins, and an AI assistant into one fast workspace. Create an account and join the Demo.
Home.featuresCopy: Fewer windows and less technical busywork — more attention for the music, the project, and the next great take.
Home.featureDawCopy: Audio and MIDI, mixing, automation, plugins, and export stay together in one uninterrupted project workflow.
Home.featureAiCopy: The assistant uses the same safe commands as the interface. Every change remains undoable.
Home.featureRecoveryCopy: The project journal saves changes in the background and restores the session after an unexpected exit.
Home.featureControlCopy: Your account shows active devices and AI usage, with one-click access revocation when you need it.
